title: Proxy & Tunnel Engine Manager
summary: Transport engines and everything that acts on the active engine: nodes and subscriptions, traffic routing, routing profiles and Cloudflare Clean IP. Balancing and health checks are in Main menu -> 5.

items.title: Transport Engines
items.description: Lists Passwall, Passwall2, sing-box, Xray, WireGuard and OpenVPN with running state, interception and the active marker; pick one to manage it.
items.usage_tip: Engines that are not installed point to the package profile that provides them.

items.title: Config Manager (Nodes & Subscriptions)
items.description: Stores proxy share links and subscription links locally and pushes them into Passwall.
items.usage_tip: Start here: add a config or a subscription before touching routing.

items.title: Traffic Routing / Shunt Rules
items.description: Applies ready-made shunt modes such as Iran direct, global proxy and direct only.
items.usage_tip: Rules can only be applied when Passwall is installed.

items.title: Routing Profiles
items.description: One-click profiles: balanced, gaming, streaming, global proxy and direct only.
items.usage_tip: Profiles simply call the routing modes for you.

items.title: Clean IP Manager
items.description: Finds reachable Cloudflare IPs for a config and replaces only the address part of the link.
items.usage_tip: Use it when a Worker or CDN address stops responding.

items.title: Back to Main Menu
items.usage_tip: Nothing is changed by leaving this menu.

items.title: Quit DayPass
items.description: Ends the DayPass session from any menu.
items.usage_tip: Ctrl+C does the same and restores the terminal.

items.title: Help
items.description: Opens the manual of the current screen.
items.usage_tip: Enter or 0 inside a manual returns to the screen you came from; q quits DayPass.
